chunks: And Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام said:
"Indeed, the fluttering of pigeons' wings drives away the devils."

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Commander of the Faithful, a title of Imam 'Ali عليه السلام

ai.seo_question: What did Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام say about the fluttering of pigeons' wings and devils?
ai.summary: Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام states that the fluttering of pigeons' wings repels the devils. The report indicates a beneficial effect associated with pigeons and reflects a transmitted teaching about unseen harm and protection.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4229 - Commander of the Faithful, peace be upon him, said:
"Indeed, the fluttering of pigeons' wings drives away the devils."
